verdict.rationale: E2B provides sandbox primitives: background command execution via `--background`, sandboxes that run up to 24 hours, pause/resume, and lifecycle webhooks. These are developer building blocks a user could assemble into autonomous jobs. The evidence shows no first-party automation feature, such as scheduled or recurring triggers, that runs autonomously in the background. A one-off background command is not a set-up automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
